task_support.symbols: any integer accepted; site = symbol*groove mod n_cells

n_cells.meaning: length of the periodic channel (number of sediment sites)

groove.meaning: spacing between the injection sites of consecutive symbols; must be < n_cells

load.meaning: amount of sediment one observed symbol drops into the flow

drift.meaning: flow speed: how far the suspended load moves downstream each step

flush.meaning: share of the suspended load exported out of the channel each step

settle.meaning: chance that a cell's entire suspended clump drops onto the bed

scour.meaning: chance that a cell's entire bed is lifted back into the flow

creep.meaning: share of each bed cell that slides one cell downstream (deterministic)

transport_work.units: sediment units per step per episode
transport_work.meaning: half the total absolute change of bed plus suspended load in one step: how much sediment moved between compartments or cells

natural_distribution.note: lists are lattices (uniform over members); pairs are uniform real intervals

history_free_control.meaning: nothing ever settles and the flow is fully exported every step, so state after a step depends only on the current symbol

full_state: concat(susp, bed) -- the whole causal state
randomness: noise(n, rng) -> {u_settle, u_scour}: (n, n_cells) uniforms; step() is deterministic given them
